session.chatViewNote: Show live sessions as chat bubbles instead of RAW terminal output. Beta — may be buggy and not always work.

permissions.cameraDesc: QR code scanning to pair with servers

crashReporting.title: Share anonymous crash reports
crashReporting.description: Send sanitized technical crash information to help improve Threadbase. Prompts, terminal output, source code, credentials, server addresses, and session content are never included.
crashReporting.testCrashConfirmMessage: This raises a test error so you can confirm reporting works. Only available in development builds.

sessionNaming.title: Session Naming
sessionNaming.autoNameNote: Set the session name from the first words of your first message. No AI, no tokens.
sessionNaming.aiGeneratedNote: Use an AI model to generate a meaningful name. Uses tokens from your configured API key.

language.restartMessage: Changing between RTL and LTR languages requires restarting the app to apply the layout changes.

notificationHealth.heading: Notification health
notificationHealth.subtitle: Per-server push registration state from the streamer. Tokens are never shown.
notificationHealth.emptyBody: Pair a server first, then check notification delivery health here.
notificationHealth.reregisterFailed: Re-registration failed. Check notification permission and try again.
notificationHealth.quietActive: Quiet hours are active now — alerts are suppressed locally.
notificationHealth.quietInactive: Quiet hours are off or not active right now.
notificationHealth.storeAvailable: Push store is available on this server.
notificationHealth.storeUnavailable: Push store is unavailable on this server (registration cannot persist).
notificationHealth.noTokens: No push tokens registered for this server yet.
notificationHealth.hintNeverDelivered: Registered, but no successful delivery yet (detection vs delivery).
notificationHealth.hintDelivery: Delivery failures are accumulating on the server — re-register or check Expo credentials.
notificationHealth.hintRevoked: This token was revoked on the server.
notificationHealth.reregisterNeedsPermission: Notifications permission is off — enable it in system settings, then retry.
notificationHealth.reregisterNeedsDevice: Could not get a push token (simulators cannot register). Try on a physical device.

pairedDevices.heading: Paired devices
pairedDevices.subtitle: Devices registered with this streamer. Credentials are never shown — only names, capabilities, and activity.
pairedDevices.emptyBody: Pair a server first, then manage its devices here.
pairedDevices.storeUnavailable: Device registry is unavailable on this server.
pairedDevices.noDevices: No devices registered yet. Pair from this app (or another) to mint one.
pairedDevices.controlNote: Devices with session control can drive the agent. Revoking removes that device’s credential only — other devices keep working.
pairedDevices.hasControl: This device can control sessions (start, send input, interrupt).
pairedDevices.revokeBody: Revoke “{{name}}”? It will lose access on the next request.
pairedDevices.revokeThisBody: Revoke this phone’s device credential? The shared owner key on this app still works; only the per-device token is invalidated.

backup.heading: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Export and restore Threadbase project metadata for this server.
backup.emptyBody: Pair a server first, then export or restore metadata here.
backup.metadataOnly: This archive is metadata only (project identity and paths). Conversations are not included — they live in provider history on disk and return when the streamer rescans.
backup.pasteHint: Paste an archive JSON below, then dry-run before applying.
backup.invalidArchive: JSON is not a recognized backup archive.
backup.pathMapHint: Optional path rewrite for a machine move (prefix from → to).
backup.dryRunReady: Dry-run complete — review the plan, then apply.
backup.applyBody: This rewrites project identity on the server. Conversations are not imported from the archive.
backup.conflict: Restore has path conflicts — resolve them before applying.
backup.conflictDetail: A path is claimed by a different project id. Applying would break one side’s links.
